description: Identifier resolution is EXACT: bare references fold to upper case, quoted ones stay verbatim, and the resolved name must match the stored one exactly on every leg (database, schema, table, column, SHOW scope) - each leg refused under the kind live names it by; a quoted reference does not reach a folded name; a runtime STRING name (IDENTIFIER('t'), TABLE('t'), GET_DDL) folds like a reference; and a missing SHOW scope is reported per KIND (six generic kinds answer the bare object sentence, ten naming kinds spell the schema). All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from ddl/IdentifierResolutionExactnessTest (now retired). The quoted mixedDb database is account-level and dropped at test end.
